title: PROVISO: Provenance-Informed Action Selection for Secure LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents act on the external world through tools and third-party skills, so a single executed action can cause irreversible harm. Existing defenses judge a proposed action without tracking whether its content comes from the user or from external sources such as tool outputs, and they judge it in isolation rather than against an available alternative, which forces a trade-off between security and utility. We present PROVISO, a controller that decides which action to commit after the agent proposes an action and before it is executed. PROVISO encodes trusted observations, external observations, the proposed action, and an alternative into provenance-typed memory, relates them through role-specific queries, and commits the action with the highest calibrated value learned from outcomes. On four agent security tasks spanning the agent lifecycle, no baseline exceeds PROVISO in both security and utility. PROVISO improves F1 over the strongest

translated_title: PROVISO：面向安全LLM智能体的基于来源信息的动作选择
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通过工具和第三方技能作用于外部世界，因此单个被执行的动作就可能造成不可逆的伤害。现有防御机制在判断一个提议的动作时，既不追踪其内容是来自用户还是来自工具输出等外部来源，也只是孤立地判断该动作而非将其与可用的备选方案进行比较，这迫使人们在安全性和实用性之间做出权衡。我们提出PROVISO，这是一个控制器，它在智能体提出动作之后、动作被执行之前决定提交哪个动作。PROVISO将可信观察、外部观察、提议的动作以及备选方案编码到带有来源类型标记的内存中，通过角色特定的查询将它们关联起来，并提交从结果中学习到的校准值最高的动作。在横跨智能体生命周期的四个智能体安全任务上，没有任何基线方法能在安全性和实用性两方面同时超越PROVISO。PROVISO在F1指标上超越了最强的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PROVISO是一个在LLM智能体动作执行前介入的控制器，通过追踪动作内容的信息来源（区分用户指令与工具输出等外部内容）并基于学习到的校准值比较备选动作，从而在不牺牲实用性的前提下提升智能体的安全性。
en_tdlr: PROVISO is a controller that intervenes before LLM agent actions are executed, by tracking the provenance of action content (distinguishing user instructions from external sources like tool outputs) and comparing alternative actions via learned calibrated values, thereby improving agent security without sacrificing utility.
